title: Painful Arc

positions.as_written: Ask the patient to move the knee actively through its range and to say when it hurts rather than whether it hurts.
Repeat passively, since pain in the same arc passively suggests a joint surface and pain only actively suggests the extensor mechanism or a muscle.
Add compression if the arc is anterior, by pressing the patella against the femur while the knee moves, which increases patellofemoral load specifically.
Ask the patient which activity reproduces the same pain, because the activity usually names the arc better than the examination does.
